description: Fix snapshot never firing and make detection layout compact single-screen
steps: STEP 1 - Remove confidence checks from triggerSnapshot in FaceDetector.tsx so it fires whenever faces are detected and have not been snapshotted yet
STEP 2 - Move snapshot display from inline video overlay to full-screen popup modal (position fixed, z-50) with composited image and download/close buttons

STEP 3 - Restructure detection view (Step 3) in page.tsx to compact single-screen: top bar with mode badge + person count + event name + stop button in one row, camera taking remaining vertical space with max-h-[60vh], compact mode toggle at bottom
STEP 4 - Remove the LED indicator div below the video in FaceDetector.tsx
STEP 5 - Remove the oversized stats card and separate mode indicator banner from page.tsx
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot triggers reliably when faces are detected (no confidence gating)
Snapshot displays as full-screen popup modal with download button
Detection view fits on one screen without scrolling
Top bar shows mode, person count, event name, and stop button in one row
Camera video has max-h-[60vh] and object-contain
Mode toggle is compact at bottom
findings: Build passes cleanly with Next.js 16.3.0 Turbopack. Net reduction of 67 lines (160 removed, 93 added). The snapshot trigger no longer depends on emotionConfidence which was being set to 0 for sub-threshold expressions.
